name: Very Merrytime Christmas Seafood Sampler (Shrimp, Jonah Crab Claw & Smoked Salmon)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Chilled poached shrimp, sweet Jonah crab claw meat, and smoked salmon provide pure, zero-fiber, ultra-lean protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request the chilled shrimp, Jonah crab claw, and smoked salmon plain with cocktail/horseradish sauce and lemon wedges on the side.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Request without lemon juice or citrus marinade on the shrimp
